intro: Tiling is the fixing of ceramic, porcelain, or stone tiles to a wall using adhesive and grout, and it's a service FixWell Services offers on its own in Salisbury and Wiltshire, not only as one stage inside a full renovation. Call +44 7391 599 078 or use the quote form for a free assessment.

sections.heading: What Tiling Work FixWell Carries Out in Salisbury
sections.body: Standalone tiling covers four distinct jobs: full wall tiling for a bathroom or shower enclosure, kitchen splashback fitting behind a hob or sink, individual tile replacement where one has cracked or come loose, and re-grouting an existing tiled area whose joints have discoloured or blown. Each is priced and booked separately from a full renovation project, which matters because a customer who only needs one wall re-tiled shouldn't have to commission an entire bathroom refit to get it done.

sections.heading: Tile Materials We Work With
sections.body: Ceramic tile is the most common choice for a standard bathroom wall, offering a durable, wipeable surface at the lower end of the cost range. Porcelain has a denser body than ceramic, better suited to higher-traffic areas like a kitchen splashback. Natural stone — limestone or travertine most often — appears in period-property renovations across Salisbury and needs a different sealant regime to stay stain-resistant. Mosaic sheet tile is used mainly for feature strips and splashback borders rather than full walls.

sections.heading: Common Tiling Repairs
sections.body: A cracked or loose individual tile is the most frequent repair call, usually caused by an impact or by the adhesive bond failing on an older installation. Blown or discoloured grout is a lower-cost fix than a full re-tile and restores a tired-looking bathroom without touching the tiles themselves. A missing tile after a fixture relocation needs a matched replacement fitted into the gap left behind.

sections.heading: How FixWell Approaches a Tiling Job
sections.body: Every tiling job starts with checking the surface: is it level, is the existing substrate plasterboard, masonry, or old tile, and does it need building up before a single tile goes on. The adhesive is matched to that substrate, because the wrong adhesive for the surface is the single most common cause of tiles coming loose within a year. Tiles are set with spacers to keep joints even, then grouted once the adhesive has cured, with the grout colour matched to what the customer wants.

sections.heading: Tiling Costs in Salisbury
sections.body: Standard wall tiling costs £35–£55 per square metre for labour, with materials quoted separately depending on the tile chosen. A full bathroom re-grout typically costs £120–£220. Single tile replacement runs £40–£90, with the higher end applying where an older or discontinued tile needs matching.

sections.heading: Is Your Job Standalone Tiling, or Part of a Bigger Renovation?
sections.body: Re-tiling one wall, fixing a splashback, or refreshing tired grout are all standalone jobs FixWell handles directly. If the tiling is one stage in a wider project — stripping out an old bathroom suite, moving plumbing, fitting new sanitaryware — that scope sits under FixWell's kitchen renovation service instead, where tiling is sequenced alongside the other trades.

sections.heading: Re-grouting and Refreshing Existing Tiling
sections.body: Grout has a working life shorter than the tiles it sits between, and re-grouting a bathroom whose tiles are otherwise sound is significantly cheaper than a full re-tile while producing a similarly refreshed look. This sits alongside FixWell's wider home repairs service in Salisbury, which covers the same category of job.

sections.heading: Tiling as Part of a Kitchen or Bathroom Renovation
sections.body: Tiling is one of the later stages in a full renovation sequence, fitted after plumbing and electrics are roughed in but before final fixtures go on. Anyone planning a full bathroom renovation in Salisbury will find tiling covered as part of that project scope.

faqs.q: How much does tiling cost per m² in Salisbury?
faqs.a: Standard wall tiling costs £35–£55 per square metre for labour. Tile size and pattern complexity affect the figure — a large-format porcelain tile with minimal cutting costs less to fit per square metre than a small mosaic requiring many precise cuts.

faqs.q: Can you re-grout my bathroom without retiling it?
faqs.a: Yes. If the tiles themselves are sound and only the grout has discoloured or cracked, re-grouting refreshes the look of the room for roughly a third of the cost of a full re-tile, typically £120–£220 for a standard bathroom.

faqs.q: Can you replace a single cracked tile without redoing the whole wall?
faqs.a: Yes, typically £40–£90. The main variable is matching the replacement to an existing tile that may be an older or discontinued range, which sometimes means sourcing from a reclamation supplier.

faqs.q: Do you do wet room tanking?
faqs.a: Basic waterproofing prep within a standard shower enclosure falls within scope. A full wet-room tanking system with a tiled floor drain is a specialist installation, and FixWell will flag this clearly rather than attempt it outside that competency.
